About BenchLM

BenchLM is an independent evaluation project. We publish reasoning, coding and retrieval leaderboards, describe our methodology openly, and re-run every suite quarterly.

Methodology

Each model is run three times against a held-out problem set. We report the mean. Runs are executed on identical hardware with identical decoding parameters. We do not accept payment from model providers and we do not share the held-out set.
